description:

  • Venue: Georgia VECTR Center (Veterans Education Career Transition Resource) Center

1001 S Armed Forces Blvd,

Warner Robins, GA 31088

                                **or**

Virtual option may be provided via Microsoft Teams (meeting link will be sent based on expressed interest)

*Briefing materials will be posted in the near future and breakout sessions will be scheduled upon receipt of your RSVP.
